# Naming Conventions Guide

Let me provide you with comprehensive naming conventions that follow Microsoft's official guidelines and industry best practices.

## Project & Solution Naming


### Solution Names
```
CompanyName.ProductName
CompanyName.ProductName.All
CompanyName.ProductName.Solution

Examples:
Microsoft.AspNetCore
Lightbridge.MedicalImaging
RadAI.DicomProcessor
```


### Class Library Names
```
CompanyName.ProductName.Component
CompanyName.ProductName.Layer

Examples:
RadAI.Imaging.Core
RadAI.Imaging.Utilities  
RadAI.Imaging.DataAccess
Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
```


### Console Application Names
```
CompanyName.ProductName.CLI
CompanyName.ProductName.Console
CompanyName.ProductName.Tool

Examples:
RadAI.DicomViewer.CLI
RadAI.ImageProcessor.Console
Microsoft.DotNet.Tools.Restore
```


### Web API Names
```
CompanyName.ProductName.Api
CompanyName.ProductName.WebApi
CompanyName.ProductName.Service

Examples:
RadAI.PatientRecords.Api
RadAI.Imaging.WebApi
Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel
```


## File Structure & Naming


### Directory Structure
```
RadAI.MedicalImaging/                 # Solution folder
├── RadAI.MedicalImaging.sln         # Solution file
├── src/                              # Source code
│   ├── RadAI.MedicalImaging.Core/   # Core library
│   │   ├── Models/                  # Models folder
│   │   ├── Services/                # Services folder
│   │   ├── Interfaces/              # Interfaces folder
│   │   └── Utilities/               # Utilities folder
│   ├── RadAI.MedicalImaging.Api/    # Web API
│   └── RadAI.MedicalImaging.CLI/    # Console app
├── tests/                            # Test projects
│   ├── RadAI.MedicalImaging.Core.Tests/
│   └── RadAI.MedicalImaging.Api.Tests/
└── docs/                             # Documentation
```


### File Naming Rules
```csharp
// One class per file, file name = class name
Patient.cs           → public class Patient
IPatientService.cs   → public interface IPatientService  
PatientService.cs    → public class PatientService
PatientDto.cs        → public class PatientDto
PatientValidator.cs  → public class PatientValidator

// Partial classes
Patient.cs           → public partial class Patient
Patient.Generated.cs → public partial class Patient

// Nested classes (avoid if possible)
Order.cs            → Contains Order + Order.OrderItem
```


## Object Naming Conventions


### Classes and Structs
```csharp
// PascalCase, noun or noun phrases
public class Patient { }
public class DicomImageReader { }
public struct Point3D { }
public record PatientRecord { }

// Avoid abbreviations (except well-known)
public class HtmlParser { }     // OK - HTML is well-known
public class JsonConverter { }  // OK - JSON is well-known
public class PatientMgr { }     // BAD - use PatientManager
```


### Interfaces
```csharp
// PascalCase with 'I' prefix
public interface IPatientRepository { }
public interface IImageProcessor { }
public interface IDisposable { }
public interface ILogger<T> { }
```


### Methods
```csharp
public class PatientService
{
    // PascalCase, verb or verb phrases
    public Patient GetPatient(int id) { }
    public void SavePatient(Patient patient) { }
    public async Task<bool> ValidateImageAsync(byte[] data) { }
    public bool IsValid() { }
    public bool HasPermission() { }
    
    // Async methods end with 'Async'
    public async Task<Patient> GetPatientAsync(int id) { }
    public async Task SavePatientAsync(Patient patient) { }
}
```


### Properties
```csharp
public class Patient
{
    // PascalCase, noun or adjective
    public string FirstName { get; set; }
    public string LastName { get; set; }
    public int Age { get; set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; set; }
    public DateTime DateOfBirth { get; set; }
    
    // Boolean properties often start with Is, Has, Can
    public bool IsValid { get; }
    public bool HasInsurance { get; }
    public bool CanEdit { get; }
}
```


### Variables and Parameters
```csharp
public class ImageProcessor
{
    // Private fields: camelCase with underscore prefix
    private readonly ILogger _logger;
    private int _processedCount;
    private static readonly string _defaultFormat = "DICOM";
    
    // Local variables: camelCase
    public void ProcessImage(byte[] imageData)
    {
        int width = 1920;
        string fileName = "scan.dcm";
        var imageInfo = new ImageInfo();
        
        // Loop variables
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) { }
        foreach (var item in items) { }
    }
    
    // Method parameters: camelCase
    public void SaveImage(string fileName, byte[] imageData, bool compress)
    {
        // ...
    }
}
```


### Constants and Enums
```csharp
public class MedicalConstants
{
    // Constants: PascalCase
    public const string DefaultModality = "CT";
    public const int MaxImageSize = 1024;
    
    // Static readonly: PascalCase
    public static readonly DateTime MinDate = new(1900, 1, 1);
}

// Enums: PascalCase (both enum and values)
public enum Modality
{
    CT,
    MRI,
    XRay,
    Ultrasound,
    PetScan     // No hyphens, use PascalCase
}

// Flags enum
[Flags]
public enum Permissions
{
    None = 0,
    Read = 1,
    Write = 2,
    Delete = 4,
    All = Read | Write | Delete
}
```


### Events and Delegates
```csharp
// Events: PascalCase
public event EventHandler ImageProcessed;
public event EventHandler<PatientEventArgs> PatientUpdated;

// Delegates: PascalCase, end with Handler/Callback
public delegate void ImageProcessedHandler(object sender, EventArgs e);
public delegate Task AsyncCallback(string message);
```


### Generics
```csharp
// Single letter T for simple cases
public class List<T> { }
public interface IRepository<T> where T : class { }

// Descriptive names for multiple type parameters
public class Dictionary<TKey, TValue> { }
public interface IConverter<TSource, TDestination> { }
```


## Special Cases & Patterns


### DTOs and ViewModels
```csharp
// Data Transfer Objects
public class PatientDto { }
public class PatientCreateDto { }
public class PatientUpdateDto { }

// ViewModels (for MVC/MVVM)
public class PatientViewModel { }
public class PatientListViewModel { }
```


### Test Classes
```csharp
// Test class = ClassNameTests or ClassNameTest
public class PatientServiceTests { }
public class ImageProcessorTests { }

// Test methods describe what they test
[Test]
public void GetPatient_WithValidId_ReturnsPatient() { }

[Test]
public async Task SavePatientAsync_WithNullPatient_ThrowsException() { }
```


### Namespaces
```csharp
// Match folder structure, PascalCase
namespace RadAI.MedicalImaging.Core.Models;
namespace RadAI.MedicalImaging.Core.Services;
namespace RadAI.MedicalImaging.Api.Controllers;
```


## Quick Reference Card


```
Type                Example
─────────────────────────────────────────
Solution:           CompanyName.ProductName
Project:            CompanyName.ProductName.Component
Namespace:          CompanyName.ProductName.Component
Class:              PatientRecord (PascalCase)
Interface:          IPatientService (I + PascalCase)
Method:             GetPatient() (PascalCase)
Async Method:       GetPatientAsync() (PascalCase + Async)
Property:           FirstName (PascalCase)
Private Field:      _firstName (underscore + camelCase)
Local Variable:     firstName (camelCase)
Parameter:          firstName (camelCase)
Constant:           MaxRetryCount (PascalCase)
Enum Type:          PatientStatus (PascalCase)
Enum Value:         Active, Inactive (PascalCase)
Event:              DataReceived (PascalCase)
Generic Type:       T, TKey, TValue
```


## Common Mistakes to Avoid


```csharp
// ❌ BAD Examples
public class patient { }           // Should be PascalCase
public interface PatientService {} // Missing 'I' prefix
private string FirstName;          // Should have underscore
public void get_patient() { }      // Should be PascalCase, not snake_case
public async Task<Patient> GetPatient() { } // Missing Async suffix

// ✅ GOOD Examples
public class Patient { }
public interface IPatientService { }
private string _firstName;
public void GetPatient() { }
public async Task<Patient> GetPatientAsync() { }
```


## Dart vs C# Comparison


```
Dart                          C#
────────────────────────────────────────
class PatientService          class PatientService
mixin ImageProcessor          interface IImageProcessor
getPatient()                  GetPatient()
_privateField                 _privateField
final String name             public string Name { get; }
var items = []                var items = new List<T>()
snake_case files              PascalCase.cs files
```
